title: Step 1 - Understanding Convolution in CNNs: Feature Detection and Feature Maps

cues.en: -: Hello, welcome back to the course on Deep Learning.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到深度學習課程。

cues.en: In the previous tutorial, we found out what convolution neural networks are all about.
cues.zh: 上一堂課了解了卷積神經網路是什麼。

cues.en: And today, we're going to dive into Step 1 Convolution.
cues.zh: 今天要深入第一步：卷積。

cues.en: So, this is the convolution function.
cues.zh: 這就是卷積函數。

cues.en: I know we tried to stay way from mathematics and keep things intuitive, but I couldn't help but share this formula with you because it is so simple.
cues.zh: 我知道我們盡量避開數學，用直覺理解，不過這個公式很簡單，我還是忍不住想分享。

cues.en: A convolution is basically a combined integration of two functions and it shows you how one function modifies the other or modifies the shape of the other.
cues.zh: 卷積基本上是對兩個函數做結合積分，顯示一個函數如何改變另一個函數，或改變它的形狀。

cues.en: And if you've done any signal processing, or electrical engineering, or a profession where signal processing is required, you would've inevitably come across the convolution function.
cues.zh: 如果學過訊號處理、電機工程，或從事需要訊號處理的專業，你一定接觸過卷積函數。

cues.en: It is quite popular.
cues.zh: 它相當常見。

cues.en: Now, once again, we're going to keep the mathematics light or keep them separate.
cues.zh: 不過我們仍會盡量簡化數學，或把它另外處理。

cues.en: And if you'd like to get into the math behind the convolution neural networks, a great additional read is "Introduction to Convolution Neural Networks"
cues.zh: 若想了解卷積神經網路背後的數學，有篇很棒的延伸閱讀 Introduction to Convolutional Neural Networks，

cues.en: by Jianxin Wu, who is a professor at the Nanjing University in China.
cues.zh: 作者是中國南京大學教授 Jianxin Wu，也就是吳建鑫。

cues.en: This paper was published, literally days ago, like five or six days ago.
cues.zh: 這篇論文真的才剛發表幾天，大約五、六天前。

cues.en: And it is oriented specifically at people who are starting out at beginners, who are getting to know convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 內容特別針對剛開始接觸卷積神經網路的初學者。

cues.en: So, the mathematics there should be accessible.
cues.zh: 因此其中的數學應該不難理解。

cues.en: I actually emailed Professor Jianxin Wu, and he said his whole goal is to break the complex things down
cues.zh: 我還寫信給吳建鑫教授，他說自己的目標就是拆解複雜概念，

cues.en: so that people who are new to this field can understand.
cues.zh: 讓剛進入這個領域的人也能理解。

cues.en: Oh, also he mentioned that he's got some materials available on his homepage.
cues.zh: 他也提到，個人首頁上有一些教材。

cues.en: So, in the URL, if you just remove the last two parts and you just go to like /WJX to that part, that's his homepage and you'll be able
cues.zh: 把網址最後兩個部分刪掉，保留到 /WJX 那一段，就是他的首頁，就能

cues.en: to find more additional tutorials and materials which haven't been published as papers but he uses them in his tutorials.
cues.zh: 找到更多教學與教材。有些沒有發表為論文，但他會用於教學。

cues.en: So you might find those useful.
cues.zh: 你可能會覺得很有幫助。

cues.en: So, browse around there if you'd like to get an introduction into the the mathematics behind convolutional neural networks and kind of build a solid base around that area.
cues.zh: 如果想初步了解卷積神經網路背後的數學、建立扎實基礎，可以去逛逛。

cues.en: But, we're going to move on and we're gonna talk about the convolution.
cues.zh: 我們則繼續談卷積。

cues.en: So, what is the convolution in intuitive terms?
cues.zh: 從直覺來看，卷積是什麼？

cues.en: Here on the left we've got an input image as we discussed.
cues.zh: 左邊是前面說過的輸入影像。

cues.en: That's how we're going to look at images, just 1's and 0's to simplify things.
cues.zh: 為了簡化，我們用 1 和 0 來看影像。

cues.en: And you can see the smiley face there.
cues.zh: 可以看到這裡有一張笑臉。

cues.en: There we've got a feature detector.
cues.zh: 這邊是特徵偵測器。

cues.en: So feature detectors are 3 by 3 matrix.
cues.zh: 這個特徵偵測器是 3 × 3 矩陣。

cues.en: Does it have to be 3 by 3?
cues.zh: 一定要是 3 × 3 嗎？

cues.en: No, it doesn't.
cues.zh: 不一定。

cues.en: Alexnet I think uses 7 by 7.
cues.zh: 我記得 AlexNet 用的是 7 × 7。

cues.en: And then some other, one of those other famous ones, uses like 5 by 5 feature detectors.
cues.zh: 其他某個知名模型，則用 5 × 5 的特徵偵測器。

cues.en: They can be different, but usually you'll see that they are 3 by 3 and there are, you know, reasons to make them 3 by 3.
cues.zh: 大小可以不同，但通常會看到 3 × 3，選擇這個大小也有其原因。

cues.en: So we we're going to stick to the conventional way, having a 3 by 3 feature detector.
cues.zh: 所以我們採用常見做法，使用 3 × 3 特徵偵測器。

cues.en: Also, the feature detector is called, these are important terms, because you might come across them.
cues.zh: 另外，特徵偵測器還有其他名稱。這些術語很重要，因為你可能會遇到。

cues.en: They're many different terms for the feature detector but the most common ones are feature detector.
cues.zh: 它有很多名稱，最常見的就是 feature detector。

cues.en: Or you might hear it being called kernel or you might hear it being called filter.
cues.zh: 也可能稱為 kernel，或 filter。

cues.en: So, in this course we're gonna be using either filter or feature detector interchangeably but just bear in mind that it has those names.
cues.zh: 本課程會交替使用濾波器與特徵偵測器這兩個名稱，記得它有這些稱呼。

cues.en: And a convolution operation is signified by an X in a circle, just as you saw in the formulas before.
cues.zh: 卷積運算以圈起來的叉號表示，如同前面公式所示。

cues.en: And here, what happens is on an intuitive level, just to think of it in terms of what is actually happening in the background rather than the mathematics.
cues.zh: 這裡先用直覺理解背後實際發生什麼事，不考慮數學。

cues.en: Well, you take this feature detector or filter and you put it on your image like you see on the left.
cues.zh: 把這個特徵偵測器，也就是濾波器，放到影像上，如左邊所示。

cues.en: So you cover the, for instance, in this case, the top left corner, the 9 pixels in the top left corner
cues.zh: 例如這裡先蓋住左上角的 9 個像素，

cues.en: and you basically multiply each value by each value.
cues.zh: 再把各個值相乘。

cues.en: So respective value.
cues.zh: 是對應位置的值相乘。

cues.en: So, the top 0 by the top left value by the top left value, then basically position number 1,1 by position 1,1,
cues.zh: 左上角的值乘以左上角的值，也就是位置 1,1 乘上位置 1,1，

cues.en: position 0,1 by 0,1, 0,2 by 0,2 and so on.
cues.zh: 位置 0,1 乘上 0,1，0,2 乘上 0,2，依此類推。

cues.en: So, it's element-wise multiplication of these matrices.
cues.zh: 這是矩陣的逐元素相乘。

cues.en: And then you add up the results.
cues.zh: 再把結果加總。

cues.en: So in this case, nothing matches up.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有任何位置匹配。

cues.en: So it's always either a 0 by 0, 0 by 1.
cues.zh: 每一項都是 0 乘 0，或 0 乘 1。

cues.en: So the results is 0.
cues.zh: 所以結果是 0。

cues.en: Here, you can see that one of them matched up, the 1 on the left matched up and therefore, we got a 1 here.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個位置匹配，左邊的 1 對上了，因此得到 1。

cues.en: Nothing matched up, nothing matched up, nothing matched up.
cues.zh: 這裡沒匹配，這裡沒匹配，這裡也沒匹配。

cues.en: Then we move on to the next row.
cues.zh: 接著移到下一列。

cues.en: So, and the step at which we're moving this whole filter is called the stride.
cues.zh: 每次移動整個濾波器的步幅，稱為 stride。

cues.en: So here we have a stride of 1 pixel.
cues.zh: 這裡的步幅是 1 像素。

cues.en: So here, you can see again, something matched up, the bottom right corner matched up.
cues.zh: 又有一個位置匹配，這次是右下角。

cues.en: Again, stride, bottom 1 in the middle, matched up here, top right 1 matched up.
cues.zh: 再移動，底部中間的 1 匹配；這裡則是右上角的 1 匹配。

cues.en: Then nothing matched up.
cues.zh: 接著沒有匹配。

cues.en: The stride is 1.
cues.zh: 步幅是 1。

cues.en: You can change the stride, you can make it 1, 2, you can make it 3, whatever you like.
cues.zh: 你可以改變步幅，設成 1、2、3，或其他你想要的值。

cues.en: Conventionally, the one that works well is usually a 2.
cues.zh: 通常表現不錯、常用的值是 2。

cues.en: So that's what people stick to.
cues.zh: 所以大家常採用它。

cues.en: And we'll talk about what the stride is towards the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂課結尾還會談步幅。

cues.en: So here we've got, we're matching up, so we just keep going.
cues.zh: 這裡繼續比對，一直做下去。

cues.en: Oh, here you can see we've got a 2 because two of them matched up and so on and so on and so on.
cues.zh: 這裡得到 2，因為有兩個位置匹配，接著依此類推。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: There's another one that matched up.
cues.zh: 又有一個位置匹配。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And, there we're done.
cues.zh: 全部完成。

cues.en: So, what have we created, right?
cues.zh: 那我們建立了什麼呢？

cues.en: Couple of important things here.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個重點。

cues.en: The image on the right is called a feature map, also has several terms.
cues.zh: 右邊的影像叫作特徵圖，它也有幾種名稱。

cues.en: It also can be called, sometimes, a convolved feature.
cues.zh: 有時也稱為 convolved feature，也就是卷積後的特徵。

cues.en: (laughs) So when you apply convolution operator to something, it doesn't become convoluted, it becomes convolved.
cues.zh: （笑）對某個東西做卷積運算，它不是變得 convoluted，而是 convolved。

cues.en: And yes, sometimes I like, I think to myself in the wrong way, but it's the correct term.
cues.zh: 我有時也會想錯，但正確用語是這個。

cues.en: It's convolved.
cues.zh: 是 convolved。

cues.en: It's a convolved feature, or it can also be called activation map.
cues.zh: 可以叫 convolved feature，也能叫 activation map，激活圖。

cues.en: But we are gonna be calling it a feature map in this course.
cues.zh: 不過本課程會稱它為特徵圖。

cues.en: So it can be called any one of those things.
cues.zh: 這些名稱都可以。

cues.en: And what have we done here?
cues.zh: 剛才我們做了什麼？

cues.en: Well, as you can see, we've reduced the size of the image.
cues.zh: 可以看到，影像尺寸縮小了。

cues.en: That's number one.
cues.zh: 這是第一點。

cues.en: And that's the important thing I wanted to mention about your input image and the featured detect and the stride, right?
cues.zh: 這也是我要強調的：輸入影像、特徵偵測器和步幅之間的關係。

cues.en: If you have a stride of 1, you can see the image reduced a bit.
cues.zh: 步幅是 1 時，影像會稍微縮小。

cues.en: But if you have a stride of 2 the image is going to reduce more.
cues.zh: 步幅是 2 時，影像會縮得更多。

cues.en: So the feature map is gonna be even smaller.
cues.zh: 特徵圖也就更小。

cues.en: And that's an very important function of the feature detector, of this whole convolution step, is to make the image smaller,
cues.zh: 特徵偵測器、整個卷積步驟的一個重要功能，就是縮小影像，

cues.en: because it'll be easier to process it and it'll be, just faster.
cues.zh: 因為這樣更容易處理，速度也更快。

cues.en: (clap) It'll be, just faster.
cues.zh: （拍手）速度會更快。

cues.en: Because, imagine like here we've got a what, a 7 by 7 image.
cues.zh: 想像一下，這裡只是一張 7 × 7 的影像。

cues.en: But imagine if you have a proper photo, right?
cues.zh: 但如果是一張真正的照片呢？

cues.en: Or you have like a 256 by 256 pixel image.
cues.zh: 或是一張 256 × 256 像素的影像。

cues.en: That's a huge number of pixel at 256 squared.
cues.zh: 256 的平方，像素數量很龐大。

cues.en: Or like, let's say you have a 300 by 300 pixels, so we don't get confused with the RGB 256 let's just say like we have a 300 by 300 image in terms of size in pixels,
cues.zh: 為了不要和 RGB 的 256 搞混，改用 300 × 300 像素的影像來說明，

cues.en: then you have 300 squared number of pixels.
cues.zh: 它就有 300 的平方個像素。

cues.en: That's a huge number.
cues.zh: 數量非常大。

cues.en: And therefore, feature detectors will reduce the size of the image, and therefore stride of 2 is actually beneficial.
cues.zh: 特徵偵測器會縮小影像，所以步幅 2 其實很有幫助。

cues.en: But then the question is, do we lose information?
cues.zh: 不過問題是，我們會損失資訊嗎？

cues.en: Are we losing information when we're applying the feature detector?
cues.zh: 使用特徵偵測器時，資訊會流失嗎？

cues.en: Well, some information we are losing, of course, because we have less values in a resulting matrix.
cues.zh: 當然會失去部分資訊，因為結果矩陣的數值數量變少了。

cues.en: But at the same time, the purpose of the feature detector is to detect certain features, certain parts of the image that are integral.
cues.zh: 但特徵偵測器的目的，是找出影像中重要的某些特徵或部分。

cues.en: And, so, for instance, if you think about it this way like the feature detector has a certain pattern on it.
cues.zh: 可以這樣想：特徵偵測器上有某種模式。

cues.en: The highest number in your feature map is when that pattern matches up.
cues.zh: 當這個模式匹配時，特徵圖的數值會最高。

cues.en: In fact, the highest number you can get is, And I'll an simplify an example, is when the feature matches exactly.
cues.zh: 在這個簡化範例中，特徵完全匹配時，就會得到最高值。

cues.en: And you can see with that number 4, we have in our feature map, that's exactly, so if you look over here, that's exactly where this feature detector,
cues.zh: 你可以看到特徵圖中的 4，正好就是這個特徵偵測器

cues.en: because there's only four 1's in it, matched perfectly.
cues.zh: 完全匹配的位置，因為裡面只有四個 1。

cues.en: So you can see this part over here.
cues.zh: 看看這個部分。

cues.en: So the feature was detected here.
cues.zh: 特徵就是在這裡被偵測到。

cues.en: And as we discuss at the very start of this section, features is how we see things, is how we recognize things.
cues.zh: 如同章節開頭所說，我們透過特徵觀看、辨識事物。

cues.en: We don't look at every single pixel, so to speak.
cues.zh: 可以說，我們不是逐個像素查看。

cues.en: In what we see on an image or in real life we don't look at every single pixel, we look at features, we look at the nose, the hats the feather,
cues.zh: 不論看影像還是現實生活，我們不是查看每個像素，而是看鼻子、帽子、羽毛等特徵，

cues.en: or the little black marks under the cheetah's eyes to distinguish it between a cheetah and a leopard, or the shape of the train.
cues.zh: 或看獵豹眼睛下方的黑色小條紋，區分獵豹與豹，也會看列車的形狀，

cues.en: To distinguish it between a bullet train and a normal train and so on.
cues.zh: 區分高速列車與一般列車，依此類推。

cues.en: We don't look at everything, we look at features and that's what we are preserving and that's what the feature map helps us preserve, actually.
cues.zh: 我們不會看所有細節，而是看特徵；這正是我們要保留，也是特徵圖幫忙保留的內容。

cues.en: That's what it allows us to bring forward and get rid of all of the unnecessary things that even as humans, we don't process this.
cues.zh: 它讓我們把這些資訊往後傳，同時去除不必要的東西，連人類也不會處理那些。

cues.en: So much information going into your eyes at any given time, like gigabytes of information if you look at every single dot, if not terabytes
cues.zh: 如果逐點計算，每一刻進入眼睛的資訊非常多，每秒可能有數 GB，甚至數 TB，

cues.en: of information going into your eyes per second.
cues.zh: 這麼多資訊進入眼睛。

cues.en: And still, we're able to process that because we get rid of what is unnecessary, we only focus on the important features.
cues.zh: 但我們仍能處理，因為會去除不必要的內容，只專注在重要特徵。

cues.en: Features are important to us.
cues.zh: 特徵對我們很重要。

cues.en: And that is exactly what the feature map does.
cues.zh: 而這正是特徵圖在做的事。

cues.en: So now, moving on, this is our input image and we created a feature map.
cues.zh: 繼續看，這是輸入影像，我們建立了特徵圖。

cues.en: So the front one, let's say the front one is the one we just created.
cues.zh: 假設最前面這張就是剛才建立的。

cues.en: But then how come there is many of them?
cues.zh: 但為什麼會有那麼多張？

cues.en: But we create multiple feature maps because we use different filters, right?
cues.zh: 因為使用不同濾波器，就會建立多張特徵圖。

cues.en: And that's another way that we preserve lots of the information.
cues.zh: 這也是保留大量資訊的另一種方式。

cues.en: So, we don't just have one feature map, we look for certain features and then basically the network decides through its training, and this is something we'll discuss
cues.zh: 不只建立一張特徵圖，而是尋找不同特徵。網路透過訓練決定，這點會在

cues.en: towards the end of this section, through its training, it decides which features are important for certain types or certain categories, and it looks for them.
cues.zh: 章節結尾討論，哪些特徵對哪些類型或類別重要，然後去尋找它們。

cues.en: And therefore it'll have different filters.
cues.zh: 因此會有不同濾波器。

cues.en: And we'll talk about filters just now, but basically it'll apply these filters.
cues.zh: 稍後會談濾波器，基本上就是套用這些不同濾波器。

cues.en: So, to get this feature map, it applied a filter like the one we saw.
cues.zh: 要得到這張特徵圖，就套用剛才看到的那種濾波器。

cues.en: But then to get this feature map, it applied a different filter, to get this feature map, it applied a different filter and so on.
cues.zh: 要得到另一張特徵圖，就用另一個濾波器，再下一張又用別的，依此類推。

cues.en: And, so basically it just creates these feature maps.
cues.zh: 就這樣建立出這些特徵圖。

cues.en: And actually, that's why personally I think the term feature detector, is better than filter.
cues.zh: 所以我個人認為，特徵偵測器這個詞比濾波器更好。

cues.en: So remember over here we have this filter, which we also can call a feature detector.
cues.zh: 記得這裡的濾波器，也能稱為特徵偵測器。

cues.en: Well, actually the word feature detector, I think, is better suited.
cues.zh: 我覺得特徵偵測器更貼切。

cues.en: And the reason for that is, that's what the purpose is, right?
cues.zh: 因為這正是它的目的。

cues.en: We don't want to just, filter out our image, but even though that's the same, just a question of terminology.
cues.zh: 我們不只是要過濾影像，雖然意思相同，只是術語選擇不同，

cues.en: But basically we want to detect features.
cues.zh: 但基本上，目的是偵測特徵。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: In this feature map, we've detected where certain features are in the image.
cues.zh: 這張特徵圖偵測到某些特徵在影像中的位置。

cues.en: In this feature map, we've detected where certain other features are, where a certain specific feature is located.
cues.zh: 另一張特徵圖偵測到其他特徵，也就是某個特定特徵的位置。

cues.en: In this feature map, we've detected where a certain other feature is located on the image.
cues.zh: 這張則偵測到影像中另一個特徵的位置。

cues.en: So that's what we are doing.
cues.zh: 這就是我們在做的事情。

cues.en: And let's have a look at a couple of examples.
cues.zh: 來看幾個例子。

cues.en: So here we're using, and this is from --.org.
cues.zh: 這裡使用的範例來自一個 .org 網站。

cues.en: Their documentation, it's a free kind of tool, like Paint and you can use it to adjust your images or work with your images.
cues.zh: 這是它的文件。它是類似小畫家的免費工具，可以調整、處理影像。

cues.en: But, basically, they have some valuable examples in their documentation.
cues.zh: 它的文件中有一些很有價值的範例。

cues.en: And here they have a picture of the Taj Mahal and you can choose which filter you want to apply.
cues.zh: 這裡有泰姬瑪哈陵的照片，你可以選擇要套用哪種濾波器。

cues.en: So if you download this program and you upload a photo into it, and then you can actually start a convolution matrix and apply filters.
cues.zh: 下載這個程式並載入照片後，就能使用卷積矩陣，套用濾波器。

cues.en: And you will see that these things, these convolution matrices, I actually applied an image processing and design and so on.
cues.zh: 你會看到，這些卷積矩陣確實應用在影像處理、設計等工作中。

cues.en: So let's have a look at what we get.
cues.zh: 來看看結果。

cues.en: So if we apply this filter, 5 in the middle, -1, -1, -1 , -1, you can see that it sharpens the image.
cues.zh: 套用中央為 5、周圍為 -1、-1、-1、-1 的濾波器，影像就會銳化。

cues.en: And yeah, so this is quite intuitive if you think of it.
cues.zh: 稍微想想，其實很直覺。

cues.en: So 5 is the pixel, the main pixel, like in the middle of the, filter or the feature detector.
cues.zh: 5 對應到濾波器，也就是特徵偵測器中央的主要像素。

cues.en: And then -1, -1, -1, just you know, kind of like reduces the pixels around it.
cues.zh: 周圍的 -1、-1、-1，則可以理解為降低周圍像素的影響。

cues.en: In an intuitive sense.
cues.zh: 這是直覺上的解釋。

cues.en: Then Blur. So basically it gives equal significance to all of the pixels around the one in the center and therefore it combines them together
cues.zh: 接著是模糊。它給中央像素周圍的像素相同的重要性，把它們結合，

cues.en: and you get a blur.
cues.zh: 就會得到模糊效果。

cues.en: Edge Enhance.
cues.zh: 接著是邊緣增強。

cues.en: So here you can see that -1 and 1 and then you get 0's, right?
cues.zh: 這裡有 -1、1，其他是 0。

cues.en: So you delete, remove, the pixels around the main one in the middle and you only keep this one at a -1.
cues.zh: 也就是移除中央主要像素周圍的像素，只保留這個 -1。

cues.en: And it gives you an edge enhance.
cues.zh: 這會產生邊緣增強效果。

cues.en: This one's a bit harder to understand how it works.
cues.zh: 這個的運作比較難理解。

cues.en: Like, probably harder just to think of it intuitively.
cues.zh: 光憑直覺比較難想像。

cues.en: Edge Detect, all right?
cues.zh: 再來是邊緣偵測。

cues.en: So this one probably makes more sense, right?
cues.zh: 這個可能比較容易理解。

cues.en: You take the middle one, you reduce the middle one,
cues.zh: 取中央的值，把它降低，

cues.en: probably like the strength of the middle pixel.
cues.zh: 可以理解為降低中央像素的強度。

cues.en: And then you look for these 1's you increase the strength of the 1's around them.
cues.zh: 再看周圍的 1，提高那些位置的強度。

cues.en: So you have the 1's there.
cues.zh: 這裡就是那些 1。

cues.en: Yeah, so that gives you like an edge texture and you can see what you get there.
cues.zh: 這樣會得到邊緣紋理，可以看到這裡的結果。

cues.en: Emboss, another one.
cues.zh: 另一個是浮雕。

cues.en: So the key here is that it's asymmetrical and you can see the image becomes asymmetrical as well.
cues.zh: 重點在於它不對稱，可以看到影像也變得不對稱。

cues.en: So you've got like that kind of feeling that it's standing out towards you.
cues.zh: 會有影像朝你凸出來的感覺。

cues.en: And that's what you get when you have like minuses here and pluses here.
cues.zh: 這裡用負值、那裡用正值，就會得到這種效果。

cues.en: Again, this is getting a bit technical now, but at least we can get some kind of intuitive understanding.
cues.zh: 雖然開始有點技術性，但至少能建立一些直覺理解。

cues.en: Lets just go quickly through them again.
cues.zh: 再快速看一次。

cues.en: There's Sharpen, there's Blur, there's Edge Enhance, there's Edge Detect, there's Emboss.
cues.zh: 這是銳化、模糊、邊緣增強、邊緣偵測，以及浮雕。

cues.en: And so as you can see, these are great examples of the same image, but we are getting feature maps.
cues.zh: 這些都是很好的範例：同一張影像，我們卻得到不同特徵圖。

cues.en: So we use different feature detectors to get different feature maps of the same image.
cues.zh: 對同一張影像使用不同特徵偵測器，就會得到不同特徵圖。

cues.en: And therefore, now, we have lots of versions of this image where in each one we've tried to detect certain things.
cues.zh: 現在有了這張影像的許多版本，每個版本都試著偵測某些東西。

cues.en: These terms, they're not applicable to us.
cues.zh: 這些效果名稱不一定都適用於我們的工作。

cues.en: They're, like I said, Emboss is probably not applicable to us in terms of convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 如同剛才說的，浮雕對卷積神經網路可能不適用。

cues.en: But Edge Detect, that's important.
cues.zh: 但邊緣偵測很重要。

cues.en: We want to detect the edges, Edge Enhance, probably not, Blur, Sharpen.
cues.zh: 我們要偵測邊緣；邊緣增強可能不需要，還有模糊、銳化這些。

cues.en: So, certain things like Edge Detect is probably the most important one for our type of work.
cues.zh: 對這類工作而言，邊緣偵測可能是其中最重要的。

cues.en: And, in terms of understanding, like computers, they will decide for themselves, their neural network will decide for itself what's important, what's not.
cues.zh: 至於電腦怎麼理解，神經網路會自行決定什麼重要、什麼不重要。

cues.en: And it probably won't be even recognizable to the human eye.
cues.zh: 那些特徵可能連人眼都無法辨認。

cues.en: You won't be able to understand what those features mean but the computer will decide.
cues.zh: 你可能看不懂特徵代表什麼，但電腦會自行決定。

cues.en: And that's the beauty of neural networks that they can process so many different things and understand without even having that intuition
cues.zh: 這就是神經網路美妙之處，能處理這麼多不同東西，即使沒有我們的直覺，

cues.en: without having that explanation why, they will understand which features are important to them.
cues.zh: 也沒有為什麼的解釋，仍能了解哪些特徵對它重要。

cues.en: Whether we have a name for them or not,
cues.zh: 不論我們是否替這些特徵命名，

cues.en: that's an irrelevant question for their artificial neural network.
cues.zh: 對人工神經網路而言都無關緊要。

cues.en: And my favorite one, here's a photo of Geoffrey Hinton passed through one of these filters.
cues.zh: 我最喜歡的是這張，Geoffrey Hinton 的照片套用了其中一個濾波器。

cues.en: All right, so that brings us to the end of today's tutorial.
cues.zh: 好，今天的教學到這裡結束。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed learning about convolution.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這次關於卷積的學習。

cues.en: The key takeaway is that a convolution, the primary purpose of a convolution is to find features in your image using the feature detector,
cues.zh: 最重要的重點是，卷積的主要目的，是透過特徵偵測器找出影像中的特徵，

cues.en: put them into a feature map, and by having them in a feature map, it still preserves the spatial relationships between pixels which is very important for us to, you know,
cues.zh: 把它們放進特徵圖，同時保留像素間的空間關係，這對我們非常重要，

cues.en: because if they're completely jumbled up, then we've lost the pattern.
cues.zh: 因為如果完全打亂，模式就消失了。

cues.en: And at the same time, it's important to understand that most of the time the features a neural network will detect and use to recognize certain images and classes,
cues.zh: 另外也要理解，神經網路用來辨識某些影像與類別的特徵，通常

cues.en: will mean nothing to humans.
cues.zh: 對人類可能毫無意義。

cues.en: But nevertheless, they work.
cues.zh: 但它們仍然有效。

cues.en: And that's what convolution is.
cues.zh: 這就是卷積。

cues.en: And I look forward to seeing you on the tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂教學與你見面。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy deep learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受深度學習的樂趣。
